verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents headless access through its public APIs and MCP server, letting people and AI agents read, write, and act on data outside the UI. Specific endpoints cover campaign creation, event tracking, and webhook management. No evidence claims or demonstrates full API parity with UI features like the drag-and-drop editors, flow building, segmentation, or reports. missing for 10: explicit UI-to-API parity statement, documented API coverage of flows/automations, segments, templates/editor content and reporting, independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Klaviyo is also accessible headlessly — through its public APIs and MCP server — so people and AI agents can read, write, and act on Klaviyo data from outside the Klaviyo interface.
Creates a campaign given a set of parameters, then returns it.
Create a new event to track a profile's activity.
Get all webhooks in an account.
Your MCP client can help with a variety of tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports.
